Paragraph: "On seeing Rama and Lakshmana then that chief of monkeys Sugreeva with much dreadfulness said this to his ministers..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Communicating leadership concerns while overwhelmed by dread.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva turns to his ministers to express his fearful suspicions.
Outcome/Resolution: He seeks collective consultation to process his fear.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Mantri-Alochana (Seeking counsel during moments of acute fear)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Surrounding oneself with wise ministers (sachivas) helps manage crisis during spiritual testing.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Seeking social support: relying on trusted advisors to co-regulate and evaluate perceived threats.
